name: searchcarriers-risk-engine
description: Advisory risk evidence, named qualifications, caller-policy checks, insurance reconciliation, and compliance snapshots for motor carriers.

tools.name: risk_score
tools.description: Calculate a disclosed legacy advisory score from safety, insurance, and authority evidence.

tools.name: qualification_reports
tools.description: Fetch API v2 personal and team named qualification results with Pass, Review, or Fail evidence.

tools.name: vetting_check
tools.description: Apply a complete caller-supplied policy and return a Pass, Review, or Fail verdict.

tools.name: insurance_check
tools.description: Validate insurance coverage status, active policies, and gap detection.

tools.name: compliance_audit
tools.description: Audit MCS-150 filing, authority status, and regulatory compliance posture.
